resources.name: airborne_ir_rim_2013
resources.notes: 33 shapefiles, EPSG:4326, 2013-08-20 01:30 PDT to 2013-09-26; filenames carry local time and layer type (Heat Perimeter, Growth, ...). Pre-2020, so outside the 2020-2024 NIROPS window asked for.

resources.name: airborne_ir_dixie_2021
resources.notes: 41 shapefiles, EPSG:4326, 2021-07-15 to 2021-09-27; mixes HeatPerimeter, IntenseHeat, ScatteredHeat layers; names inconsistent (KMZ/kmz, '(#2)'). Dixie overlaps GOFER and the Choi US set.

resources.name: feds_conus_2021_lf_perimeter
resources.licence: CC-BY-4.0 (FEDS CONUS Archive 2012-2025, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22921773; supersedes Chen et al. 2022 California archive)
resources.notes: FlatGeobuf, EPSG:9311 (US National Atlas Equal Area), 62,760 12-hourly perimeters, 1,645 fireIDs, t 2021-01-01 to 2021-12-31 (00:00/12:00 UTC steps). Fields: fireID, mergeid, t, t_st, t_ed, farea (km2), fperim, flinelen, n_pixels, n_newpixels, meanFRP, isactive, isdead, primarykey. Large-fire (>4 km2) post-processed product.
